EN: So now I have to do this alone. Awesome.
ZH: 所以说我只能一个人去了是么。太棒了。

EN: Really wish I had some help.
ZH: 真希望有人能帮我。

EN: I think I need backup!
ZH: 我想我需要支援。

EN: I can do this by myself... Right?
ZH: 我一个人能行的……对吗？

EN: Now I know why the buddy system is so popular...
ZH: 现在我知道为什么大家都爱结伴同行了……

EN: So alone. I hope I don't start talking to myself. Oh... Great.
ZH: 好孤单。但愿我还没开始自言自语。哦……这下可好。

EN: Wish I had some company. Someone to talk to, share the experience... draw enemy fire.
ZH: 真希望有个人陪，能说说话，聊聊这次的经历，顺便……替我引开敌人的火力。

EN: What am I, some kind of action movie hero, going it alone? I need backup!
ZH: 我算什么，非要学动作片英雄单枪匹马吗？我需要支援！

EN: There's never another Dweller around when you need them...
ZH: 当你需要其他居民时，居然一个都不在……

EN: This whole “lone wolf” thing is probably a colossally bad idea.
ZH: 什么“孤狼”做派，八成是个天大的馊主意。

EN: Live alone, die alone. How depressing.
ZH: 一人生，一人死。真让人抑郁。

EN: Waiter, table please. Party of one. *sigh*
ZH: 服务员，麻烦给张桌子，就一位。唉。

EN: Going solo. Don't have to share the loot. It's the little things.
ZH: 一个人去，战利品就不用跟人分了。小确幸嘛。

EN: It's not the being alone that stinks. It's the soul-crushing loneliness.
ZH: 不是说一个人有多糟糕，而是那种深入骨髓的孤独感让人无法承受。

EN: What a dump.
ZH: 真是个垃圾堆。

EN: I left the Vault for this?
ZH: 我离开避难所就是为了这个？

EN: Did I just step in... Oh, gross.
ZH: 我刚才是不是踩到了……哦，真恶心。

EN: I was promised an adventure. Someone lied.
ZH: 说好了是场冒险的。有人撒了谎。

EN: People actually live out here?
ZH: 真的有人住在这种地方？

EN: Now I know why they call it a Wasteland.
ZH: 现在我知道为什么他们称之为“废土”了。

EN: This place is disgusting. Shocker.
ZH: 这地方真恶心。呵，真“意外”。

EN: Okay. I'm about ready to go home now.
ZH: 好吧。我准备好回家了。

EN: WHAT is that smell?
ZH: 这到底是什么鬼味道？！

EN: That chill... I think a ghost just passed through me.
ZH: 那阵寒意……我觉得刚有只鬼穿过了我的身体。

EN: The Overseer had better appreciate this.
ZH: 监督者最好懂得感激。

EN: Why did I agree to do this?
ZH: 为什么我会同意来做这个？

EN: “It'll be fun!” they said. Yeah. “Fun.”
ZH: 他们都说：“去吧，会很有意思的！”呵呵，真“有意思”。

EN: I'm doing this for the experience, right?
ZH: 我做这个是为了增长见识，对吧？

EN: What I wouldn't give for a hot bath...
ZH: 要能洗个热水澡，让我干什么都行……

EN: Ow, my achin' feet.
ZH: 嗷，我的脚好痛。

EN: My body aches all over.
ZH: 我全身都疼。

EN: I think I've had enough excitement for one day.
ZH: 我觉得今天的刺激已经够多了。

EN: Living out here doesn't seem bad. It seems HORRIBLE.
ZH: 住在外头不是“没那么糟”——是糟透了！

EN: Death everywhere. I need an anti-depressant.
ZH: 遍地尸骸。谁给我来点抗抑郁药。

EN: Where's some hand sanitizer when you need it?
ZH: 需要免洗消毒液的时候，它都在哪儿呢？

EN: I can't wait to get out of here.
ZH: 真恨不得马上离开这个鬼地方。

EN: Wow, “adventuring” sure does get old quick.
ZH: 哇，“冒险”这玩意儿果然很快就腻。

EN: I need an aspirin.
ZH: 我需要阿司匹林。

EN: Never thought I'd say this, but I miss the Vault.
ZH: 从没想过我会说这句话，但我真的好想念避难所。

EN: I'd really like to sleep in my own bed tonight...
ZH: 好想今晚能睡在自己的床上……

EN: Hey, a dead rat on the floor. How charming.
ZH: 嚯，地上还有只死老鼠，真够风雅的。

EN: I can feel the dirt and grime seeping into my skin...
ZH: 我能感觉到泥土和灰尘渗进了我的皮肤。

EN: I deserve hazard pay for this.
ZH: 做这个应该给我发危险工种补贴吧。

EN: I can't believe I'm not even getting paid for this.
ZH: 真不敢相信，干这个居然连钱都不给。

EN: Smells bad, looks bad, sounds bad... IS bad.
ZH: 气味很糟糕，看起来很糟糕，听上去也很糟糕……总之就是糟糕透了。

EN: This place is a goldmine of bacteria.
ZH: 这地方简直就是细菌的天堂。

EN: Eww. Got something on my shoe.
ZH: 呃。我鞋子上粘了什么鬼东西。

EN: I'm never going to wash this stink out of my clothes.
ZH: 这股臭味是永远从衣服上洗不掉了。

EN: This place is depressing.
ZH: 这地方真压抑。

EN: The Wasteland Survival Guide never prepared me for THIS.
ZH: 《废土生存指南》可没教过我应付这种事。

EN: The Vault must be Heaven, cause this place... Ya know.
ZH: 避难所一定是天堂，因为这鬼地方……你懂的。

EN: Must not give in to fear...
ZH: 不能向恐惧低头……

EN: I can get through this...
ZH: 我一定能挺过去的……

EN: They need to fire their interior decorator.
ZH: 真该把他们的室内设计师炒了。

EN: Floor... so... sticky...
ZH: 地板……好……好黏……

EN: How do people actually live out here?
ZH: 怎么会有人住在这里？

EN: Thank goodness I actually have a Vault to go home to.
ZH: 谢天谢地，好歹还有个避难所可以回。

EN: This place is giving me irritable bowel syndrome.
ZH: 这地方都快让我得肠易激综合征了。

EN: I love what they've done with the place.
ZH: 我可太“喜欢”他们把这地方折腾成的样子了。

EN: They really need a Mister Handy to tidy this place up.
ZH: 这里真的需要巧手先生来打扫一下。

EN: Would it kill them to dust every now and then?
ZH: 他们时不时打扫一下这里会死吗？

EN: If I die here, I'm going to be so mad.
ZH: 我要是死在这儿，一定气得做鬼都不安生。

EN: And I thought it was depressing OUTSIDE.
ZH: 我还以为外面已经够压抑了。

EN: Really starting to hate this place...
ZH: 真心开始讨厌这个地方了。

EN: Just have to remember, I'll be home in the Vault soon...
ZH: 只需要记住，我马上就能回到避难所温暖的家了……

EN: Why'd I ever agree to leave the Vault?
ZH: 我为什么会同意离开避难所？

EN: This isn't as bad as I imagined. It's worse.
ZH: 这儿没我想的那么糟——是更糟。

EN: Wow, humans really did screw things up royally.
ZH: 哇，人类真擅长把事情搞砸。

EN: Geez, and I thought my quarters back in the Vault needed dusting...
ZH: 天啊，我还以为需要打扫的只是我在避难所里的“小窝”……

EN: And I agreed to do this because...?
ZH: 再提醒我一下，我当初为什么同意做这个……？

EN: Fresh coat of paint, some flowers, this place would look... Okay, never mind.
ZH: 重新刷层漆、再摆点花，这地方看起来就会……算了，当我没说。

EN: What's that smell? Oh, of course. Death.
ZH: 那是什么味道？还能是什么，当然是死亡的味道。

EN: HATE this place...
ZH: 讨厌死这地方了……

EN: If I had a sixth sense, it would be going haywire right now.
ZH: 要是我有第六感，这会儿它一定在疯狂示警。

EN: Starting to think humans should never come up to the surface. Like, ever.
ZH: 开始觉得人类永远都不应该从避难所里出来。永远不。

EN: If my parents could only see me now...
ZH: 要是爸妈能看到我现在这副样子就好了……

EN: Without running water, I wonder how anyone... Oh. Oh, I see.
ZH: 没有流水的话，不知道大家都是怎么……哦哦，我懂了。

EN: The sanitary conditions in here are just deplorable.
ZH: 这里的卫生条件真是恶劣透顶。

EN: It's not the radiation out here that scares me. It's the cooties.
ZH: 这里吓到我的不是辐射，而是虱子。

EN: Wow. Sometimes it just feels like one room after another...
ZH: 哇，有时候感觉就是一个房间接着一个房间，永无止境……

EN: I think they need to fire their maid.
ZH: 我觉得他们该把女佣辞了。

EN: To heck with Nuka-Cola. I need a stiff whiskey.
ZH: 去他的核子可乐，我需要来杯烈威士忌。

EN: The Vault really needs a massage therapist. SO much tension in my shoulders...
ZH: 这个避难所真的需要一个按摩师。我的肩膀太僵硬了。

EN: Life used to be so simple. Power. Water. Food. Now look at me.
ZH: 以前日子多简单。电。水。吃的。再看看我现在。

EN: I'm going to need therapy after this. So much therapy.
ZH: 这趟差事结束之后我得看看心理医生，得看好久。

EN: Optimism. Must maintain my optimism...
ZH: 乐观。一定要保持乐观……

EN: Well, I wanted some adventure. Be careful what you wish for...
ZH: 当初是我想来点冒险。许愿可得小心，小心它应验……

EN: I'm starting to think this was a mistake.
ZH: 我开始觉得这是一个错误了。

EN: So am I, so am I...
ZH: 我也是，我也是……

EN: Did you hear that?
ZH: 你听到了吗？

EN: Yeah – sounded like it's close.
ZH: 是的……听上去就好像在附近。

EN: Did you bring the sandwiches?
ZH: 你带了三明治吗？

EN: You said you were bringing them...
ZH: 你说你会带的呀……

EN: Sandwiches? I thought you said tacos.
ZH: 三明治？我记得你说的是卷饼啊？

EN: Oh, so I'm your servant now?
ZH: 哦，合着我现在是你的仆人了？

EN: How you doing? Holding up?
ZH: 最近怎么样？还撑得住吗？

EN: Yup! No worries!
ZH: 是的！别担心！

EN: Exhausted and generally terrified, but otherwise okay.
ZH: 精疲力尽而且吓得不轻，但其他的还好。

EN: How do you THINK I'm doing?
ZH: 你说我还能怎么样？

EN: Know any good jokes?
ZH: 你知道什么不错的笑话吗？

EN: Nope.
ZH: 不知道。

EN: I do, but they wouldn't be appropriate right now.
ZH: 我知道，但好像不怎么适合现在讲。

EN: Sorry. I left my clown nose back in the Vault.
ZH: 抱歉。我把我的小丑鼻子留在避难所了。

EN: Any thoughts?
ZH: 有什么想法吗？

EN: Two. No three. I'll tell you them later.
ZH: 两个，不，三个。我晚点和你说。

EN: Not right now. Saving my brain energy.
ZH: 现在不行，我省着脑力呢。

EN: Ssshh. More walk, less talk.
ZH: 嘘。多走路，少说话。

EN: I'm scared.
ZH: 我有点害怕。

EN: It'll be okay! You can do this!
ZH: 一定没事的！你可以的！

EN: Me too. Because we're probably going to die.
ZH: 我也是。因为我们可能会死的。

EN: Darn it, stay strong! We need you!
ZH: 该死的，别犯怂啊！我们需要你！

EN: Think we'll make it back to the Vault?
ZH: 你觉得我们能安全回到避难所吗？

EN: Of course! We're just THAT awesome!
ZH: 当然了！我们那么厉害！

EN: What? Didn't you get the memo? SUICIDE, MISSION.
ZH: 什么？你没收到备忘录吗？本次任务：自杀。

EN: Possible. But highly unlikely.
ZH: 也许吧。但基本不太可能。

EN: Weird place, huh?
ZH: 诡异的地方，对吧？

EN: Right??
ZH: 对吧？？

EN: Weird doesn't even begin the describe it...
ZH: 诡异还不足以形容这里……

EN: Don't be a snob.
ZH: 别这么嫌弃嘛。

EN: This place gives me the creeps.
ZH: 这个地方让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

EN: Yeah, me too. Stay alert.
ZH: 是啊，我也是。保持警惕。

EN: You're paranoid. What could possibly go wrong?
ZH: 你是不是有妄想症啊？能出什么事啊？

EN: Really? I kind of like it.
ZH: 是么？我还挺喜欢的。

EN: Give me a status report.
ZH: 给我汇报一下进度。

EN: Operating at full efficiency! Sort of...
ZH: 正以最高效率运转！算是吧……

EN: Um... I'm... In a weird place? With you?
ZH: 呃，我是不是……在一个奇怪的地方？和你一起？

EN: EXCUSE me? Who elected you Overseer?
ZH: 你说什么？谁选你当监督者了？

EN: What are we doing here again?
ZH: 我们来这儿是干什么的来着？

EN: Serving the Vault and the Overseer! Hooray!
ZH: 为避难所和监督者服务！万岁！

EN: Wait, what? I thought you knew?
ZH: 等等，什么？我以为你知道的。

EN: If you don't know, we are in a LOT of trouble...
ZH: 如果你不知道的话，我们麻烦可大了……

EN: Do you think the Overseer appreciates us?
ZH: 你觉得监督者会感激我们做的一切吗？

EN: What? Are you serious? Of course!
ZH: 什么？你是认真的？当然！

EN: I often wonder the same thing myself...
ZH: 我有时候也会这么想……

EN: You DARE question the Overseer's intentions?!
ZH: 你竟敢质疑监督者的用意？！

EN: You smell that?
ZH: 你闻到了吗？

EN: Flowers? No wait? Chocolate?
ZH: 是花吗？不对等等，难道是巧克力？

EN: Yeah. It's like... blood. And poo.
ZH: 嗯。感觉是……血。还有屎。

EN: You want a friend who sniffs, get a dog.
ZH: 想要个整天东闻西嗅的朋友，你养条狗不就得了。

EN: You hear that?
ZH: 你听到了吗？

EN: I hear YOU. And I wish I didn't.
ZH: 我听到你的声音了。真希望我没听到。

EN: Screaming? Music? Someone screaming along to music?
ZH: 尖叫声？音乐？伴随着音乐的尖叫声？

EN: Sorry. I hear at an entirely different frequency.
ZH: 抱歉。我的听觉跟你们完全不在一个频段。

EN: What do you think happens when you die?
ZH: 你觉得你死之后会怎么样？

EN: We'll talk about it later. In Hell.
ZH: 我待会儿再和你说。在地狱里。

EN: Well, your body rots. And someone takes your stuff.
ZH: 你的身体开始腐坏，然后有人拿走你的东西。

EN: Easy! You go to the great Vault in the sky!
ZH: 简单！你会去天上那座大避难所！

EN: Have you ever met the Overseer?
ZH: 你见过监督者吗？

EN: Ha! No one EVER meets the Overseer...
ZH: 哈！根本没有人见过监督者……

EN: Sadly, no. I have not been deemed worthy!
ZH: 可惜，没有。人家觉得我不够格！

EN: Oh, of course. We sup together regularly.
ZH: 哦，当然。我们常常会一起吃晚饭。

EN: I've got a bad feeling about this...
ZH: 我有种不祥的预感……

EN: Really? I have a pretty good feeling about it!
ZH: 真的吗？我怎么感觉特别好呢！

EN: Same here. We're in... the danger zone.
ZH: 我也一样。我们处在……危险区域。

EN: Nobody asked you about your feelings.
ZH: 没人问你怎么想的。

EN: My body aches all over.
ZH: 我全身都疼。

EN: Mine too. Questing sure is strenuous.
ZH: 我也是。执行任务果然很艰苦。

EN: I feel great! You need to hit the gym more.
ZH: 我感觉棒极了！你该多去去健身房。

EN: I really don't want to think about your body right now.
ZH: 我现在真不想去想你的身体的事。

EN: So tired...
ZH: 好累……

EN: Not me. I'm fueled by Nuka-Cola and Sugar Bombs.
ZH: 我可没有。核子可乐和糖衣炸弹麦片让我精力充沛。

EN: You need a new bed. Have you considered memory foam?
ZH: 你需要一张新床。你有考虑过记忆床垫吗？

EN: I know what you mean. Walk, walk, walk...
ZH: 我明白你的意思。我们一直在走，走，走……

EN: I get this feeling sometimes. Like I'm being watched...
ZH: 我有时候也会有这种感觉。就像一直被人监视一样……

EN: You are... By me.
ZH: 你是啊，被我监视着。

EN: They say the Overseer sees all, knows all...
ZH: 他们说监督者无所不见，无所不知……

EN: I know what you mean. Creepy, right?
ZH: 我懂你的意思。怪吓人的，对吧？

EN: Do these adventuring clothes make me look fat?
ZH: 这些探险服是不是特别显胖？

EN: No. The fat makes you look fat.
ZH: 不，是你的脂肪让你显得胖。

EN: Oh stop! You're gorgeous!
ZH: 别说啦，你这么美！

EN: Wow. That's not a loaded question at all.
ZH: 哇。这可真是个别有用心的问题。

EN: Got any snacks?
ZH: 带零食了吗？

EN: I was just about to ask you the same thing.
ZH: 我正想问你同样的事情。

EN: I got, let's see... Nothing.
ZH: 我这儿有……让我看看……啥也没有。

EN: Hello! Vault Dweller. Not a vending machine...
ZH: 你好！避难所居民在此——不是自动贩卖机……

EN: Hey, you think I'm Overseer material?
ZH: 嘿，你觉得我是当监督者的料吗？

EN: If you have to seek validation from me, then obviously not.
ZH: 如果你还需要找我寻求肯定，那你显然不是当监督者的料。

EN: Overseer? You? Ha ha ha ha ha ha.
ZH: 监督者？你吗？哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

EN: Totally! You'll have my full support. If we get back alive.
ZH: 当然了！我全力支持你。只要我们能活着回去。

EN: You know the real trick to going on a Quest?
ZH: 你知道去执行任务的真正诀窍吗？
